overall_notes: This paper focuses on backchannel prediction (classification task for timing and type of backchannels) rather than natural language generation. The system predicts when to generate backchannels and what category they belong to, but does not generate the actual linguistic content. The paper uses automatic metrics (F1, Precision, Recall) for evaluation but no human or LLM evaluation. Future work mentions planned user dialogue experiments.
